videos.headline: Hunter Luepke hauls in 32-yard TD to put NDSU in front
videos.description: North Dakota State takes the lead after Hunter Luepke makes the catch and jukes two defenders for the TD.

tracking.trackingName: NCF_One-Play (Hunter Luepke scores 32-yard receiving TD) 2021/12/18 ESHEET

videos.headline: Antwane Wells Jr. snags 13-yard TD to put JMU on the board
videos.description: Antwane Wells Jr. becomes JMU's single-season, receiving touchdown leader with his 15th of the season.
